title: Decimal place value
explanation: Digits after the decimal represent tenths, hundredths, thousandths, etc.

title: Division by powers of ten
explanation: Dividing by 10,100,1000 shifts the decimal left by the number of zeroes.

title: Decimal multiplication
explanation: Multiply as integers/fractions and place the decimal using total decimal digits.

title: Products below one
explanation: A product need not be larger than both factors.

title: Decimal division
explanation: Use fractions, powers of ten, or long division to divide decimals.

title: Long division with decimal quotient
explanation: Place value regrouping extends to quotients with decimals.
